logging_steps = 1

fields.description: Root folder for run outputs.

fields.description: Default precision for VAE, text stack, adapters, and most weights.

fields.description: Full SDXL weights file — not a LoRA.

fields.description: UNet-only style training when omitted adapter.

fields.description: Trains toward velocity instead of noise — required for v-pred checkpoints (e.g. NoobAI vpred). Wrong setting trains toward the wrong target: previews wash out or oversaturate.

fields.help: Rescales the noise schedule so the last timestep is pure noise (https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.08891) and samples previews with trailing timestep spacing. Defaults to the v_pred value (v-pred checkpoints are trained this way); set it explicitly to override.

fields.description: Diffusers semantics: hidden_states[-(clip_skip + 2)]. So for anime checkpoints trained with A1111 'Clip skip 2', leave this empty. Changing it re-encodes the text cache.

fields.description: Min-SNR loss weighting (typical value 5): caps the loss weight of low-SNR (high-noise) timesteps so they don't dominate training. Composes with debiased_estimation_loss when both are set — this trainer applies both independently, not as alternatives.

fields.description: Debiased-estimation loss weighting by timestep SNR. Composes with min_snr_gamma when both are set — this trainer applies both independently, not as alternatives.
fields.help: Debiased-estimation loss weighting by timestep SNR. Composes with min_snr_gamma when both are set — this trainer applies both independently, not as alternatives.
fields.label: Debiased estimation loss

fields.description: Per-group LR override for the UNet parameter group; empty uses optimizer.lr. 0 sets that group's lr to 0 (no updates) while the other groups keep training.
fields.help: Per-group LR override for the UNet parameter group; empty uses optimizer.lr. 0 sets that group's lr to 0 (no updates) while the other groups keep training.

fields.description: Per-group LR override for text_encoder (CLIP-L); empty uses optimizer.lr. 0 sets that group's lr to 0 (no updates).
fields.help: Per-group LR override for text_encoder (CLIP-L); empty uses optimizer.lr. 0 sets that group's lr to 0 (no updates).

fields.description: Per-group LR override for text_encoder_2 (OpenCLIP-bigG); empty uses optimizer.lr. 0 sets that group's lr to 0 (no updates).

fields.label: Text encoder 2 LR override

fields.description: Autocast dtype for the UNet forward pass; defaults to Model dtype.
fields.help: Sets training forward autocast (main.py). SDXL has no separate checkpoint-load dtype path (unlike Cosmos/Krea 2's transformer_dtype) — this only changes the forward-pass compute dtype, not how weights are loaded from disk.

fields.description: Large image/diffusion checkpoint (e.g. Anima preview).
fields.help: Example: Anima preview or another Cosmos Predict2 release as a single .safetensors on disk. This file is the core diffusion model. Do not point here at the VAE or text encoder — those have their own fields below.

fields.description: Encodes images to latents for training.
fields.help: Usually the Qwen image VAE paired with Cosmos/Anima (e.g. qwen_image_vae.safetensors). Training reads your images through this file to build latent caches.

fields.description: Turns captions into conditioning (file or folder).
fields.help: Converts dataset captions into conditioning vectors. Required for modern Anima/Cosmos setups that use Qwen3. Set llm_adapter_lr = 0 unless you intentionally train the small LLM adapter.

fields.description: Extra weights on top of the text encoder, if you have them.
fields.help: Leave empty unless your checkpoint pack includes a separate LLM adapter file to load.
fields.label: Text adapter (.safetensors)

fields.description: Finetune only. The embedded Qwen3 LLM adapter is frozen by default (0); set a value to train it.
fields.help: Finetune-only LR for the embedded Qwen3 LLM adapter; frozen by default (0), set a value to train it.
fields.label: LLM adapter LR

fields.description: Stores the frozen DiT linears as 4-bit NF4 (~1/4 the VRAM of bf16); the adapter trains on top at full precision. Turn on when the base model does not fit — pair with adapter type LoKr (LyCORIS kinds refuse a quantized base).
fields.help: Adapter training only — the quantized base stays frozen while the adapter trains in full precision on top. Roughly quarters the DiT's VRAM. Mutually exclusive with model.transformer_fp8_matmul. Use adapter type LoKr: it is quantization-aware, while the LyCORIS kinds reject a quantized base.
fields.label: Quantize base to 4-bit (NF4)

fields.description: DiT checkpoint load only; defaults to Model dtype. VAE/text unchanged.
fields.help: Defaults to model.dtype. Applies to most weights in transformer_path; VAE, text encoder, and embedder/norm layers still use model.dtype. Leave empty unless you need a different load precision (VRAM / load errors).
fields.label: Main model load dtype

fields.description: Autocast dtype for DiT forward; defaults to model.dtype. Sets transformer_dtype when omitted.
fields.help: Sets the training forward autocast dtype (main.py). Defaults to model.dtype. On Cosmos, when set and transformer_dtype is omitted, it is also copied to transformer_dtype for the checkpoint load.
fields.label: DiT forward dtype

fields.description: Alternative text encoder — a raw T5 checkpoint used instead of llm_path.
fields.help: Single .safetensors or compatible layout. Pick either llm_path (Qwen3) or t5_path, not both, unless you know your checkpoint bundle requires a specific combination.
fields.label: Text encoder — T5 (alternative)

fields.description: Per-group LR override for self-attention DiT parameters (adapter or finetune — both route through this grouping); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.help: Per-group LR override for self-attention DiT parameters (adapter or finetune — both route through this grouping); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.label: Self-attention LR override

fields.description: Per-group LR override for cross-attention DiT parameters (adapter or finetune); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.help: Per-group LR override for cross-attention DiT parameters (adapter or finetune); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.label: Cross-attention LR override

fields.description: Per-group LR override for MLP/feed-forward DiT parameters (adapter or finetune); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.help: Per-group LR override for MLP/feed-forward DiT parameters (adapter or finetune); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.label: MLP LR override

fields.description: Per-group LR override for the adaLN-modulation DiT parameters (adapter or finetune); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.help: Per-group LR override for the adaLN-modulation DiT parameters (adapter or finetune); empty uses optimizer.lr, 0 freezes the group.
fields.label: AdaLN modulation LR override

fields.description: Fixed timestep-shift transform t' = (t*shift)/(1+(shift-1)*t) (> 0) applied after sampling; overrides flux_shift when set. Empty leaves timesteps unshifted unless flux_shift is enabled.
fields.help: Fixed timestep-shift transform t' = (t*shift)/(1+(shift-1)*t) (> 0) applied after sampling; overrides flux_shift when set. Empty leaves timesteps unshifted unless flux_shift is enabled.
fields.label: Fixed timestep shift
fields.placeholder: empty = no shift (unless flux_shift is on)

fields.description: Flux-style resolution-aware timestep shift (shifts sampling toward higher noise at larger latent sizes); ignored whenever model.shift is set.
fields.help: Flux-style resolution-aware timestep shift (shifts sampling toward higher noise at larger latent sizes); ignored whenever model.shift is set.
fields.label: Flux-style resolution shift

fields.description: Scale applied to the logit-normal sample before sigmoid, only used when timestep_sample_method is logit_normal. Raising it pushes sampled timesteps toward the extremes (near 0 or 1).
fields.help: Scale applied to the logit-normal sample before sigmoid, only used when timestep_sample_method is logit_normal. Raising it pushes sampled timesteps toward the extremes (near 0 or 1).
fields.label: Logit-normal sigmoid scale

fields.description: How training timesteps are sampled per step: logit_normal (default, concentrates around mid-range noise levels) or uniform (uniform in [0, 1]).
fields.help: How training timesteps are sampled per step: logit_normal (default, concentrates around mid-range noise levels) or uniform (uniform in [0, 1]).
fields.label: Timestep sample method

fields.description: fp8 scaled-matmul quantization of the frozen DiT's big linears (mutually exclusive with transformer_4bit). Measured ~70% SLOWER on Ada (RTX 4080) and fp8-sensitive on Cosmos — an experimental/compat lever; transformer_4bit is the recommended VRAM-saving option.
fields.help: fp8 scaled-matmul quantization of the frozen DiT's big linears (mutually exclusive with transformer_4bit). Measured ~70% SLOWER on Ada (RTX 4080) and fp8-sensitive on Cosmos — an experimental/compat lever; transformer_4bit is the recommended VRAM-saving option.
fields.label: Quantize base to fp8 (scaled matmul)

fields.description: Weight fp8 format for transformer_fp8_matmul. On Ada (RTX 4080), torch._scaled_mm rejects e5m2 weights (e4m3 is required there), but Cosmos is fp8-sensitive to e4m3 outliers — measure before relying on this.
fields.help: Weight fp8 format for transformer_fp8_matmul. On Ada (RTX 4080), torch._scaled_mm rejects e5m2 weights (e4m3 is required there), but Cosmos is fp8-sensitive to e4m3 outliers — measure before relying on this.
fields.label: fp8 weight format

fields.description: The big DiT checkpoint you train (official raw.safetensors or ComfyUI file). A diffusers transformer folder also works. Optional when the diffusers folder below is set.
fields.help: The official raw.safetensors or ComfyUI's krea2_raw_bf16.safetensors — original key layout is converted automatically. A diffusers transformer folder also works. Pre-quantized fp8/nvfp4 'scaled' files cannot be trained; use the bf16 file.
fields.label: Main model (.safetensors)

fields.description: Qwen-Image VAE — the same file Cosmos/Anima setups use. Encodes images to latents for training. Optional when the diffusers folder below is set.
fields.help: One .safetensors (ComfyUI layout, converted automatically) or a diffusers VAE folder. Training reads your images through this file to build latent caches.
fields.label: Image VAE (.safetensors)

fields.description: Turns captions into conditioning (ComfyUI file or transformers folder). Tokenizer is bundled. Optional when the diffusers folder below is set.
fields.help: ComfyUI's qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors works as-is (vision weights are ignored; the tokenizer is bundled with rengu). Captions are encoded once into the cache; the encoder never runs during training steps.
fields.label: Text encoder — Qwen3-VL (.safetensors)

fields.description: Full Krea-2-Raw diffusers folder (transformer/, vae/, text_encoder/); fills any of the three component paths left empty. Set either this or the three files above.
fields.help: Optional. If you downloaded the whole krea/Krea-2-Raw folder (transformer/, vae/, text_encoder/, tokenizer/ subfolders), point here and leave the per-component fields empty — each one resolves as <checkpoint_path>/<subfolder>. Files you set explicitly always win. Never a repo id; nothing is downloaded.
fields.label: Diffusers folder (alternative)

fields.description: Folder with tokenizer files; defaults to the bundled Qwen3-VL tokenizer.
fields.help: rengu ships the Qwen3-VL tokenizer, so leave this empty. Changing it re-encodes the text-embedding cache.
fields.label: Tokenizer override

fields.description: Prompt token budget before truncation (default 512). Lower it to shrink the text-embedding cache; captions longer than this lose their tail.
fields.help: Also caps the text-embedding cache entry size — Krea 2 caches a 12-layer hidden-state stack per token, so halving this halves the cache for long captions. Compaction already trims unused padding, so lowering it only matters when captions actually reach the limit.
fields.label: Max caption tokens

fields.description: Stores the frozen DiT block linears as 4-bit NF4 (~7 GB instead of ~26 GB bf16); the adapter trains on top at full precision. A 16 GB card needs 4-bit or fp8 (transformer_fp8_matmul) — pair with adapter type LoKr (LyCORIS kinds refuse a quantized base).
fields.help: Adapter training only — the quantized base stays frozen while the adapter trains in full precision on top. Krea 2's DiT drops from ~26 GB bf16 to ~7 GB (text fusion stays bf16). A 16 GB card needs 4-bit or fp8 (model.transformer_fp8_matmul, the faster and more accurate one on RTX 40xx); they are mutually exclusive. Use adapter type LoKr: it is quantization-aware, while the LyCORIS kinds reject a quantized base.
fields.label: Quantize base to 4-bit (NF4)

fields.description: DiT checkpoint load only; defaults to Model dtype. VAE/text unchanged.
fields.help: The VAE and the Qwen3-VL text encoder keep model.dtype; adapters default to float32 (adapter.dtype). Leave empty unless you need a different DiT load precision. For VRAM, use transformer_4bit / transformer_fp8_matmul instead.
fields.label: Main model load dtype

fields.description: Advanced — leave empty. Fixed timestep shift (> 0), overriding the reference Krea 2 resolution-aware dynamic shift (mu 0.5 at 256 latent tokens to 1.15 at 6400, i.e. an equivalent fixed shift of exp(mu) ~1.65 to ~3.16).
fields.help: Empty uses the reference Krea 2 schedule: mu from 0.5 at 256 latent tokens to 1.15 at 6400 (1024x1024 = 4096 tokens), equal to a fixed shift of exp(mu) ~1.65 to ~3.16. A number (> 0) replaces it at every resolution — only for a deliberate schedule A/B.
fields.label: Fixed timestep shift

fields.description: Advanced — the default 1.0 is the reference. Scale applied to the logit-normal sample before sigmoid (logit_normal only); raising it pushes sampled timesteps toward the extremes (near 0 or 1).
fields.help: Only used with timestep_sample_method = logit_normal. Raising it pushes sampled timesteps toward the extremes (near 0 or 1).
fields.label: Logit-normal sigmoid scale

fields.description: Advanced — logit_normal (default) is the reference Krea 2 training distribution (mid-range noise levels); uniform samples t evenly in [0, 1].
fields.help: logit_normal concentrates steps on mid-range noise levels, like the reference Krea 2 training; uniform samples t evenly in [0, 1]. The resolution-aware shift (or model.shift) is applied on top of either.
fields.label: Timestep sample method

fields.description: Tensorwise-scaled e4m3 quantization of the frozen DiT's big linears (mutually exclusive with transformer_4bit): 1 byte/param drops the base 25.6 -> 12.9 GB, and the cuBLASLt kernel hits ~2x bf16 GEMM throughput under compile_scope = "block". Quant error is 2.65% RMS vs NF4's 9.55%; pair with model.fp8_grad_mode for the backward precision.
fields.help: Adapter training only: the DiT drops from ~25.6 to ~12.9 GB (2.65% RMS weight error vs NF4's 9.55%), and with compile = true + compile_scope = "block" the matmuls run ~2x faster on RTX 40xx (sm89+). Mutually exclusive with transformer_4bit; use adapter type LoKr.
fields.label: Quantize base to fp8 (tensorwise scaled matmul)

fields.description: Input-gradient GEMM precision through the frozen fp8 base, only used when transformer_fp8_matmul is on: fp8 measures ~15-20% faster per step, bf16 (default) keeps the clean gradient.
fields.help: 'bf16' (default) keeps the backward's input-gradient GEMM unquantized for a clean gradient; 'fp8' runs it through the same e4m3 tensorwise kernel as the forward, measured ~15-20% faster per step. Only takes effect when model.transformer_fp8_matmul is true.
fields.label: fp8 backward gradient precision

fields.description: The 14 GB DiT you train: ComfyUI's qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors (a diffusers transformer/ folder also works). Optional when the diffusers folder below is set.
fields.help: ComfyUI's qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors (its fused img_mlp.gate_up is split on load), a diffusers-layout file or the diffusers transformer/ folder. Pre-quantized int8_convrot / fp8 files cannot be trained; use the bf16 file.
fields.label: Main model (.safetensors)

fields.description: Qwen-Image 2.1's own RGBA VAE: ComfyUI's qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors (or the diffusers vae/ folder). Optional when the diffusers folder below is set.
fields.help: ComfyUI's qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors (original layout, converted on load), a diffusers-layout file or the diffusers vae/ folder. Training reads your images through it to build the latent cache.
fields.label: Image VAE (.safetensors)

fields.description: ComfyUI's qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors (or the transformers text_encoder/ folder); includes the vision tower edit training needs. Optional when the diffusers folder below is set.
fields.help: ComfyUI's qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors or the diffusers text_encoder/ folder; both carry the vision tower that edit training (control_path) uses. Captions are encoded once into the cache; int8 / w4a8 files are refused.
fields.label: Text encoder — Qwen3-VL-8B (.safetensors)

fields.description: The whole Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 diffusers download (transformer/, vae/, text_encoder/, processor/); fills any of the three file fields above left empty. Set either this or the three files.
fields.help: Optional. Point at the folder holding transformer/, vae/, text_encoder/ and processor/ (e.g. the Hugging Face cache snapshot) and leave the file fields empty — each resolves to <folder>/<subfolder>; files you set explicitly always win. Never a repo id; nothing is downloaded.
fields.label: Diffusers folder (alternative)

fields.description: Folder with the tokenizer files; defaults to <diffusers folder>/processor, else the bundled Qwen3-VL tokenizer.
fields.help: Defaults to <diffusers_path>/processor, else the Qwen3-VL tokenizer and image processor bundled with rengu (identical tokenization of the Qwen-Image 2.1 prompt template).
fields.label: Processor / tokenizer override

fields.description: How the 17.5 GB Qwen3-VL-8B encoder runs while captions are cached: auto (default) streams its 36 decoder layers from pinned host RAM when it does not fit in free VRAM, stream always does, none loads it whole onto the GPU.
fields.help: auto (default): stream the 36 decoder layers one at a time from pinned host RAM when the encoder does not fit in free VRAM (~2 GB VRAM, ~16 GB host RAM); stream: always; none: load it whole onto the GPU (needs ~20 GB free). The encoder loads only when captions still need encoding and is unloaded after caching.
fields.label: Text encoder placement

fields.description: Tensorwise-scaled e4m3 quantization of the frozen DiT's block linears (mutually exclusive with transformer_4bit): the base drops from ~14.2 to ~7.3 GB. Needs an sm89+ GPU (RTX 40xx / Ada); pair with blocks_to_swap on 8-16 GB cards.
fields.help: Adapter training only. The 7B DiT drops from ~14.2 GB to ~7.3 GB. Needs an sm89+ GPU (RTX 40xx / Ada); on older cards use transformer_4bit with LoKr instead. Mutually exclusive with model.transformer_4bit. The 8 GB recipe pairs it with blocks_to_swap = 24 and activation checkpointing.
fields.label: Quantize base to fp8 (tensorwise scaled matmul)

fields.description: Stores the frozen DiT block linears as 4-bit NF4 (~4 GB instead of ~14 GB bf16); the adapter trains on top at full precision. Pair with adapter type LoKr (LyCORIS kinds refuse a quantized base).
fields.help: Adapter training only — the quantized base stays frozen while the adapter trains in full precision on top. The 7B DiT drops from ~14 GB bf16 to ~4 GB. Mutually exclusive with model.transformer_fp8_matmul. Use adapter type LoKr: the LyCORIS kinds reject a quantized base.
fields.label: Quantize base to 4-bit (NF4)

fields.description: Input-gradient GEMM precision through the frozen fp8 base, only used when transformer_fp8_matmul is on: fp8 is faster, bf16 (default) keeps the clean gradient.
fields.help: 'bf16' (default) keeps the backward's input-gradient GEMM unquantized; 'fp8' runs it through the same e4m3 tensorwise kernel as the forward (faster). Only takes effect when model.transformer_fp8_matmul is true.
fields.label: fp8 backward gradient precision

fields.description: DiT checkpoint load only; defaults to Model dtype. VAE/text unchanged.
fields.help: The VAE, the Qwen3-VL text encoder and the adapters keep model.dtype. Leave empty unless you need a different DiT load precision.
fields.label: Main model load dtype

fields.description: Fixed timestep shift (> 0), overriding the resolution-aware dynamic shift of the reference scheduler (exponential, mu 0.5 at 256 latent tokens to 0.9 at 8192; 1024x1024 = 4096 tokens). Empty keeps the dynamic default.
fields.help: By default training timesteps follow the reference scheduler's exponential shift: mu interpolates from 0.5 at 256 latent tokens to 0.9 at 8192 (1024x1024 = 4096 tokens, mu ~0.70). A number here replaces it for every resolution.
fields.label: Fixed timestep shift

fields.description: Scale applied to the logit-normal sample before sigmoid, only used when timestep_sample_method is logit_normal.
fields.help: Only used with timestep_sample_method = logit_normal. Raising it pushes sampled timesteps toward the extremes (near 0 or 1).
fields.label: Logit-normal sigmoid scale

fields.description: How training timesteps are sampled per step: logit_normal (default) or uniform.
fields.help: logit_normal concentrates steps on mid-range noise levels; uniform samples t evenly in [0, 1]. The resolution-aware shift (or model.shift) is applied on top of either.
fields.label: Timestep sample method

fields.description: The Nanosaur2 DiT you train (nanosaur2_diffusion_model.safetensors).
fields.help: nanosaur2_diffusion_model.safetensors from well9472/Nanosaur2-670M (1.33 GB). Train on this base file, not nanosaur2_dmad_4step_diffusion_model.safetensors (a 4-step distilled checkpoint for inference only). The VAE and text encoder have their own fields below.
fields.label: Main model (.safetensors)

fields.description: Nanosaur2's semantic DINOv2 VAE (nanosaur2_vae.safetensors).
fields.help: nanosaur2_vae.safetensors (0.26 GB): a DINOv2-based semantic VAE with 64 latent channels and 16x downsampling. It is not interchangeable with the Qwen/Wan image VAE. Training reads your images through it once to build the latent cache.
fields.label: Image VAE (.safetensors)

fields.description: nanosaur2_text_encoder.safetensors (Gemma3-270M; its tokenizer is inside the file).
fields.help: nanosaur2_text_encoder.safetensors (0.54 GB): the frozen Gemma3-270M with its SentencePiece tokenizer stored inside the file, so no tokenizer folder is needed. Captions are encoded once into the cache; the encoder never runs during training steps.
fields.label: Text encoder — Gemma3-270M (.safetensors)

fields.description: Probability that a captioned sample skips the SPRINT sparse middle blocks, so the model keeps learning the path-drop pass its alternate/path_drop guidance uses. Reference 0.05.
fields.help: Probability that a captioned sample skips the SPRINT sparse middle blocks, so the model keeps learning the path-drop pass its alternate/path_drop guidance uses. Reference 0.05.
fields.label: Path-drop rate (captioned samples)

fields.description: Same, for samples whose caption was dropped (dataset uncond_fraction, 0.1 by default for this model). Reference 0.5.
fields.help: Same, for samples whose caption was dropped (dataset uncond_fraction, 0.1 by default for this model). Reference 0.5.
fields.label: Path-drop rate (caption-dropped samples)

fields.description: DiT checkpoint load only; defaults to Model dtype. VAE/text unchanged.
fields.help: Defaults to model.dtype. Applies to the DiT weights in transformer_path; the VAE and the adapters keep model.dtype (the text encoder runs in fp32). Leave empty unless you need a different load precision.
fields.label: Main model load dtype

fields.description: logit_normal (default) is the reference recipe: sigmoid of a normal centered at ln 2 (noisier timesteps favored); uniform samples t evenly in [0, 1].
fields.help: logit_normal (default) is the reference recipe: sigmoid of a normal centered at ln 2 (noisier timesteps favored); uniform samples t evenly in [0, 1].
fields.label: Timestep sample method

fields.description: Std of the logit-normal before sigmoid (reference 1.0).
fields.help: Std of the logit-normal before sigmoid (reference 1.0).
fields.label: Logit-normal sigmoid scale

fields.description: Advanced — leave empty. The reference recipe trains without a shift.
fields.help: Advanced — leave empty. The reference recipe trains without a shift.
fields.label: Fixed timestep shift

sections.title: Model

sections.description: LoRA or LoKr when supported; omit for full-model finetune.

fields.description: Uncheck for full-model finetune when the model supports it.
fields.help: When checked, only the adapter parameters train — the base model stays frozen and the adapter file is small and portable (ComfyUI/Forge compatible). Uncheck to train all weights (full finetune); also set optimizer.gradient_release = true and blocks_to_swap if the full model does not fit in VRAM.
fields.label: Train with adapter (LoRA / LoKr / LyCORIS)

fields.description: Options depend on the selected model.
fields.help: LoRA exports the widely compatible lora.safetensors; LoKr and every LyCORIS type export adapter_model.safetensors with kohya-style keys (loads in ComfyUI). LyCORIS types use the lycoris-lora library: LoCon (classic LoRA), LoHa (Hadamard product), LoKr (Kronecker product), DoRA (LoCon + weight decomposition, often closer to full finetune at low rank), DyLoRA (trains nested ranks so you can truncate after training), GLoRA (adds input-side adaptation), Diag-OFT and BOFT (orthogonal rotations that preserve base-model weight norms).
fields.label: Adapter / network type

fields.description: Controls how many parameters the adapter adds (typical values: 8, 16, 32).
fields.help: Higher rank = more adapter parameters and larger saved file. Alpha defaults to rank (scale 1.0); raise alpha for stronger adapter effect, lower for weaker. If results look blurry or under-trained, try a higher rank; if the adapter overrides the base too aggressively, lower rank or alpha.
fields.label: Rank

fields.description: Start from an existing LoRA/LoKr (.safetensors or folder).
fields.help: Path to a prior run export or downloaded adapter. Folder should contain adapter_model.safetensors (or a single .safetensors file).
fields.label: Init from existing adapter path

fields.description: Dtype for adapter weights (default float32).
fields.help: Precision the adapter (LoRA/LoKr) weights are stored and updated in; forward matmuls still run in model.dtype via autocast. In bfloat16 a plain-optimizer update below ~0.2% of a weight's magnitude rounds to zero, so training can stall (flat loss, normal grad norm) — keep float32 unless you pair 16-bit with a Kahan/stochastic-rounding optimizer (adamw8bitkahan, adamw_optimi). A kaon optimizer (adakaon, nekaon, …) instead handles this through its own bf16_method kwarg: "stochastic_rounding" (default, no extra state), "kahan8"/"kahan16" (compact Kahan, for low LR or fp32 fidelity), "kahan" (legacy, fp16 only), or "none". See the optimizer guide.
fields.label: Adapter dtype

fields.description: Probability of dropping adapter activations during training (default 0.0 = off).
fields.help: Probability of dropping adapter activations during training, in [0, 1]. Default 0.0 (off). Small values (e.g. 0.05–0.1) can regularize and reduce overfitting on small datasets. Applies to LoRA and all LyCORIS types.
fields.label: Dropout

fields.description: Shapes the LoKr Kronecker split per layer; -1 (default) picks the most balanced pair.
fields.help: -1 splits each dimension into near-square factors (128 -> 8x16, 512 -> 16x32). A positive value forces that factor when it divides the dimension (factor 4: 128 -> 4x32) — smaller factors shrink the adapter at some capacity cost. Leave at -1 unless you are matching a known recipe or chasing a smaller file.
fields.label: LoKr factor

fields.description: LoKr: decompose both Kronecker factors (default false).
fields.help: LoKr only. When true, both Kronecker factors are low-rank decomposed instead of just one — more expressive but larger. Default false. Leave off unless you specifically need the extra capacity.
fields.label: LoKr decompose_both

fields.description: LoKr: use full matrices for the second factor (default false).
fields.help: LoKr only. When true, the second Kronecker factor uses full matrices instead of a low-rank approximation — higher capacity at the cost of size. Default false.
fields.label: LoKr full_matrix

fields.description: Zeroes random rank rows of the adapter each step (default 0.0 = off).
fields.help: Per-step dropout over the adapter's rank dimension, in [0, 1]. A light value (0.05-0.1) regularizes inside the low-rank factorization; try it if a small dataset overfits before the style converges.
fields.label: Rank dropout

fields.description: Skips the entire adapter on a layer with this probability per step (default 0.0 = off).
fields.help: Each step, an adapted layer keeps base-only behavior with this probability, so the frozen model stays visible during training. Use a small value if the adapter drowns out the base model's general knowledge.
fields.label: Module dropout

fields.description: Also trains the existing LayerNorm/GroupNorm weights alongside the adapter (default off).
fields.help: Exports them as w_norm/b_norm keys, which ComfyUI loads with the rest of the file. Try it when global tone, contrast, or palette refuses to shift at a rank that otherwise works. SDXL only — the Cosmos DiT has no trainable norm weights, so the run fails fast there.
fields.label: Train norm layers

fields.description: Only attaches the adapter to modules whose path matches one of these glob patterns (empty = all modules).
fields.help: Patterns match the full dotted module path (e.g. unet.down_blocks.0...attn1.to_q on SDXL, blocks.0.self_attn... on Cosmos). *attn* trains attention only — smaller file with the capacity focused on composition/identity instead of textures.
fields.label: Target include patterns

fields.description: Skips modules whose path matches any of these glob patterns, applied after the include list (empty = skip none).
fields.help: Same path matching as Target include. E.g. *ff* (SDXL) or *mlp* (Cosmos) leaves the feed-forward layers untrained. If include and exclude together match nothing, the run fails at startup instead of training an empty adapter.
fields.label: Target exclude patterns

fields.description: Also adapts Conv2d layers (resnet/sampling convs), not just Linear (default off).
fields.help: Off matches the lora/lokr targets (attention + MLP Linear layers). On attaches the network to every Conv2d in the UNet blocks too — larger file and slower steps, more grip on texture. Turn on if fine surface detail refuses to transfer at a rank that otherwise works. Not supported for lycoris_dylora.
fields.label: Train conv layers

fields.description: Tucker-decomposes conv kernels (only acts when Train conv layers is on).
fields.help: Adds a small core tensor (lora_mid) between the down/up factors on non-1x1 convs, cutting conv adapter parameters. It has no effect on Linear layers, so leave it off unless train_conv is on.
fields.label: Tucker decomposition

fields.description: Adds a trained scale that starts at 0 so the weight factors can init non-zero (default off).
fields.help: Standard init zeroes the up factor so training starts as a no-op; use_scalar instead initializes both factors and multiplies the delta by a learned scalar starting at 0. The scalar is folded into the exported tensors, so files stay loader-compatible.
fields.label: Trained scalar

fields.description: Computes the DoRA magnitude over the output axis (default on).
fields.help: Only matters when DoRA decomposition is active (dora_wd). On = one magnitude per output channel (lycoris default); off = per input column. Leave on unless reproducing a recipe that used the input axis.
fields.label: DoRA output axis

fields.description: DoRA weight decomposition on top of this algorithm: the adapter trains the direction, a per-channel magnitude trains separately (default off).
fields.help: Splits each adapted weight into a trained magnitude (dora_scale) and the algorithm's delta as direction. Often tracks full finetuning better at low rank, at a per-step compute cost. Toggle it on locon/loha/lokr to add DoRA to that base.
fields.label: DoRA decomposition

fields.description: Scales the adapter delta by alpha/sqrt(rank) instead of alpha/rank (default off).
fields.help: Rank-stabilized LoRA: standard scaling shrinks the effective update as rank grows; sqrt scaling keeps it steady. Worth trying at rank 32+. The exported per-module alpha is adjusted (alpha x sqrt(rank)) so loaders reproduce the trained strength unchanged.
fields.label: Rank-stabilized scale

fields.description: LoKr: swaps which output factor each Kronecker side gets (default off).
fields.help: The output dimension factors into a (small, large) pair; this gives W1 the large one instead. Capacity moves between the two Kronecker factors — a recipe-matching knob, leave off otherwise.
fields.label: Unbalanced factorization

fields.description: DyLoRA: the rank trains in nested blocks of this size; rank must divide evenly (default 4).
fields.help: Each step updates a random sub-rank that is a multiple of block_size, so the exported LoRA stays usable when truncated to any multiple of block_size after training. Smaller blocks give finer rank choices but noisier updates.
fields.label: Block size

fields.description: OFT: caps the rotation magnitude per layer; 0 = uncapped (default).
fields.help: Positive values bound the norm of the rotation generator (scaled by layer width) — the constrained-OFT variant. Raise it from 0 if the adapter drifts the model too far from base behavior. Exported as the file's per-module alpha.
fields.label: OFT constraint

fields.description: OFT: adds a trained per-channel scale on top of the rotation (default off).
fields.help: Pure OFT only rotates weights, preserving their norms. Rescaled OFT adds a learned diagonal scale (saved as 'rescale'), letting magnitudes change too — slightly more expressive, slightly less base-preserving.
fields.label: Rescaled OFT

fields.description: Train the adapter only on these layer groups (pick one or several). Empty trains every targeted linear. Combines with the include/exclude glob patterns below.
fields.help: Train the adapter only on these layer groups (pick one or several). Empty trains every targeted linear. Combines with the include/exclude glob patterns below.
fields.label: Layer groups

fields.help: Train the adapter only on these layer groups (pick one or several). Empty trains every targeted linear. Combines with the include/exclude glob patterns below.
